findings.summary: v2 applyTargetedValidation/validateSliceCorrection weaker than v1 on outcomes and regression.evidence
findings.evidence: validateSliceCorrection omits OUTCOMES/regression.evidence checks, defaults missing regression to no-regression, accepts detected:true with empty impacted_slices; no v2 rejection tests
findings.why_it_matters: A validator can approve the active slice with an incomplete regression/outcomes contract
findings.acceptance_criteria: Parity fail-closed with v1/design for outcomes and regression; reject detected:true without impacts; explicit tests for each unhappy path

findings.summary: migrateReviewLineage does not fail closed on legacy regression.detected without attributable impacts
findings.evidence: attachRemediationV2/migrateReviewLineage ignore regression.detected attribution; missing negative fixture test
findings.why_it_matters: Migration can seed slice authority from unattributable legacy regression history
findings.acceptance_criteria: Fail-closed on migration + negative fixture; O4.2 with detected:false remains valid

findings.summary: slice.resolutions can diverge from status after validation
findings.evidence: validateSliceCorrection does not update slice.resolutions; assertRemediationV2 does not require status↔resolutions consistency
findings.why_it_matters: Consumers reading resolutions may disagree with authoritative status
findings.acceptance_criteria: Sync resolutions on pass/fail/reopen; invariant in assertRemediationV2; named test

findings.summary: freezeFindings does not attach remediation-v2 by default
findings.evidence: freezeFindings attaches v2 only with manifest/remediation_v2 flag; new lineages stay v1 until migration-required
findings.why_it_matters: Operational risk of forgetting audited manifest on new freezes
findings.acceptance_criteria: Auto-attach v2 on freeze or tested explicit migration-required deferral contract
